entities.summary: Eugene Thacker is an American author. He is a professor of media studies at Parsons School of Design in New York City. His writing is associated with the philosophies of nihilism and pessimism. He is known for his books In the Dust of This Planet and Infinite Resignation. Eugene Thacker was a journalists & chroniclers from United States (b. 2000). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
